issue.title: Stuck-agent auto-poke and auto-restart on extended inactivity
acceptanceCriteria: New patrol \`checkStuckAgentRemediation\` runs in deacon, checks health-classifier output
Stage 1 (poke), Stage 2 (restart), Stage 3 (mark troubled) wired in with the timings above
Per-stage counter logged so we can tell which stage is doing useful work
Unit tests for each stage transition
No regression: agents that are actively working (low health = stuck false alarm) are not poked

blocker.title: Per-agent `bd ready` subprocess runs every patrol before stage eligibility
